name: Local Phong Shading with Semi-Analytical Integration
definition: Extension of the semi-analytical method to include diffuse shading by reconstructing the shading function d(t) as a quadratic polynomial along the ray.
summary: Local Phong Shading with Semi-Analytical Integration enhances volume rendering by reconstructing shading as a quadratic polynomial for analytical integration, requiring only one extra sample per cell to capture lighting extremums.
